tools.name: resolveEnvironment
tools.description: Resolves which Mobiscroll framework and major version a project uses, from the contents of its package.json. This server runs remotely and has no access to the local filesystem, so the file contents are passed in as packageJsonContent. Returns the framework and major version that the other tools in

tools.name: listComponents
tools.description: Returns all available Mobiscroll UI components for a given framework and major version, with a short description and entity count for each.

tools.name: getComponentSchema
tools.description: Returns the API schema (options, events, methods, renderers) for a Mobiscroll component. Two-step, token-efficient flow: (1) call WITHOUT names to get a compact index - every entity as name + kind + tsType + a one-line summary. (2) Review the index, then call AGAIN with names:[...] to get the full d

tools.name: searchExamples
tools.description: Search for Mobiscroll examples by query, framework, major version, and component filters. Supports multi-keyword queries — all keywords must match (AND logic). Results are sorted by relevance (title matches rank highest).

tools.name: getExampleById
tools.description: Get a complete example by ID, including source files, description, and implementation instructions (when available). The ID of a retired example returns the example that replaces it, with redirectedFrom and a notice.

tools.name: validateCode
tools.description: Validate a code snippet against the component schema, checking for unknown props/events/methods and deprecated usage. Static analysis only — no execution.

tools.name: resolveConnectEnvironment
tools.description: Resolves which Mobiscroll Connect SDK (language and version) a project depends on, from the contents of its dependency manifest, and returns the Connect API and SDK versions this server documents. This server runs remotely and has no access to the local filesystem, so the manifest contents are passe

tools.name: listConnectEndpoints
tools.description: Lists all Mobiscroll Connect REST API endpoints (method, path, summary, auth). Use getConnectEndpointSchema for full parameter/response detail of one endpoint.

tools.name: getConnectEndpointSchema
tools.description: Returns the full schema of a single Connect REST endpoint: method, path, parameters (query/body) with types, authentication, response statuses, and examples. Resolve by endpointId (from listConnectEndpoints) or by method + path. Describes the endpoint from documentation; does not call it. Documents

tools.name: listConnectSdkMethods
tools.description: Lists the resources (auth, calendars, events) and methods exposed by one language's Connect SDK. Use getConnectSdkMethod for the full signature/doc of one method.

tools.name: getConnectSdkMethod
tools.description: Returns the full schema of one SDK method in one language: signature, parameters, return type, doc comment, and example. Identify the method by canonical id ("events.create"), by the language method name ("ListAsync"), or "resource.method".

tools.name: searchConnect
tools.description: Keyword search across Connect REST endpoints and SDK methods. Space-separated keywords, all must match (AND). Results sorted by relevance.

tools.name: mapConnectEndpointToSdk
tools.description: Given a Connect REST endpoint, returns the equivalent SDK call (method name, signature, example) in each language. Resolve by endpointId or by method + path. Optionally restrict to one language. Describes the endpoint and SDK call from documentation; does not call either. Documents the Mobiscroll Co

tools.name: getConnectErrorTaxonomy
tools.description: Returns the shared Connect error taxonomy: each error category with its HTTP status and the language-idiomatic exception type. Optionally filter the exception column to one language.
